request: create a new spec for issue #388
expectations: linking fees, member payments or journal entries to organisations
linking organisations to events or rehearsals
context: area: src/StageFright.Core/Entities (Transaction has MemberId but no organisation link)
area: src/StageFright.Core/Modules/Finance (RecordExpenseRequest has free-text Payee; RecordIncomeRequest has none)
constraint: financial records immutable, so links are set at entry time only
constraint: every neutral resx key translated into all shipped cultures
constraint: backup/restore schema must carry new data

FR-001.title: Organisations screen in main nav with sortable paged grid (name, email, contact count)

FR-002.title: Add organisation with required name, optional address and receipts email

FR-003.title: Refuse duplicate active organisation names, case- and space-insensitive

FR-004.title: Validate email format and field lengths with inline messages

FR-005.title: Edit organisation name, address and email

FR-006.title: Archive and restore organisations without deleting data

FR-007.title: Show-archived switch and live name search on the list

FR-008.title: Add, edit, remove contacts (name required; role, phone, mobile, email optional)

FR-009.title: Removing a contact hides it without deleting data

FR-010.title: Optional organisation choice on expense and income entry, fixed at recording, payee pre-fill

FR-011.title: Organisation financial history, newest first, with totals paid and received

FR-012.title: History totals count only the bank-side movement once per entry

FR-013.title: History amounts use the configured currency formatting

FR-014.title: Audit-trail entries for organisation and contact changes

FR-015.title: Backup and restore include organisations, contacts and links; old backups restore empty

FR-016.title: All new text translated into every shipped language
tests: tests/StageFright.Localization.Tests (Us1/Us2 guards now include the Organisations area)

intent: Keep a small CRM-style register of external organisations with contacts and linked financial history

decisions.decision: Link organisation via nullable ExternalOrganisationId on JournalEntry, set at creation
decisions.why: Each expense/income is exactly one journal entry; ledger lines stay untouched so no-organisation postings are byte-identical
decisions.rejected: Column on every Transaction line, or a separate link table

decisions.decision: History amount = sum of the entry's DebitAmount; direction from JournalEntryType
decisions.why: A balanced entry's debit total equals the money that crossed the bank, counted once
decisions.rejected: Locating the bank line by IsBankAccount, or summing debits and credits

decisions.decision: Name types ExternalOrganisation / ExternalOrganisationContact
decisions.why: Settings.OrganizationName already means the society itself
decisions.rejected: Bare Organisation type

decisions.decision: Service-level case-insensitive duplicate check plus filtered NOCASE unique index
decisions.why: Friendly localized message plus DB backstop, mirroring EventTypeConfiguration
decisions.rejected: Index only or service only

decisions.decision: Archiving an organisation does not cascade to contacts
decisions.why: Restore must bring the organisation back whole without guessing which contacts were removed by hand
decisions.rejected: Cascading soft delete with cascading restore

decisions.decision: Organisations menu DisplayOrder 2; Rehearsals, Events, Finance, Reports shift +1
decisions.why: A tie with Members would depend on invisible DI registration order
decisions.rejected: Tie at 1 relying on stable sort

decisions.decision: Backup schema 1.3.0 with envelope members 27/28 and JournalEntryBackupDto member 6; restore organisations before journal entries
decisions.why: Protobuf is additive so 1.2.0 files restore to an empty register; older apps refuse 1.3.0 instead of dropping data
decisions.rejected: Staying on 1.2.0

decisions.decision: Shared ExternalOrganisationValidationService for per-field messages
decisions.why: FR-004 needs messages next to fields, and MemberValidationService only throws a single message
decisions.rejected: Service-thrown single ValidationException only

decisions.decision: IOrganisationHistoryService added as contract §4.9 rather than renumbering §4
decisions.why: tasks.md cites §4.6 and §4.8 by number
decisions.rejected: inserting as §4.6 and shifting later sections

decisions.decision: Unknown organisation id returns an empty history; the History tab checks existence via IExternalOrganisationService.GetByIdAsync
decisions.why: history service then needs only IJournalEntryRepository
decisions.rejected: history service throwing EntityNotFoundException (needs the org repository too)

decisions.decision: OrganisationTabs takes Id plus a string Active (details/contacts/history); each tab page renders its own h1 and archived badge
decisions.why: strip loads no data and needs no extra enum file
decisions.rejected: an OrganisationTab enum, or passing the whole organisation into the strip

decisions.decision: Added Organisations_Tabs_* (4), Organisations_Contacts_PageTitle and Organisations_History_PageTitle keys to contract §7
decisions.why: the new tab strip and tab pages need localized labels and titles
decisions.rejected: reusing heading keys as tab labels

decisions.decision: Pulled T030, T039 (save requests) and T074 (journal-entry backup DTO field) into Phase 2
decisions.why: T007 validation service takes both requests, and BackupDtoFieldParityTests fails as soon as T004 adds the JournalEntry column
decisions.rejected: holding T007 until US1/US2, or leaving the parity guard red until the Backup phase

decisions.decision: IExternalOrganisationRepository.IsActiveNameInUseAsync(name, excludeId) compares trimmed names OrdinalIgnoreCase in C#
decisions.why: research 4: SQLite NOCASE folds ASCII only, so the stricter C# check runs first and the filtered unique index is the backstop
decisions.rejected: comparing in SQL through the NOCASE column

decisions.decision: Archived-organisation reads use a filtered Include on Contacts
decisions.why: IgnoreQueryFilters on the root also drops the contacts soft-delete filter
decisions.rejected: plain Include after IgnoreQueryFilters

decisions.decision: IExternalOrganisationContactRepository has no extra members; contacts are listed through the organisation Contacts include
decisions.why: contract 4.8 defines it empty
decisions.rejected: a per-organisation list method on the contact repository

decisions.decision: Added OrganisationsResource to the hard-coded NEUTRAL_RESX list in scripts/generate-pseudo-locale.py
decisions.why: the generator does not discover areas, so T015 could not create the new qps-ploc file otherwise
decisions.rejected: hand-writing the qps-ploc file

decisions.decision: RestoreAsync on an already-active organisation is a no-op with no audit entry
decisions.why: Nothing changed, so nothing to audit
decisions.rejected: Throwing a validation error

decisions.decision: Pages are not registered in MauiProgram yet
decisions.why: tasks.md gives DI and the menu to Phase 7
decisions.rejected: Wiring DI inside US1

decisions.decision: ContactEditor saves through IExternalOrganisationContactService itself and raises OnSaved; parent remounts it with a fresh @key per open
decisions.why: contract 3.6 OnSaved means after a successful add or update; @key gives clean fields without OnParametersSet diffing
decisions.rejected: parent owning the save call, or re-seeding the editor in OnParametersSet

decisions.decision: Editor field labels reuse the Organisations_Contacts_Col* keys
decisions.why: contract 7 defines no separate contact label keys; column titles are the same words
decisions.rejected: adding new label keys across 8 resx files

decisions.decision: Built Phase 4 inline rather than dispatching a worker
decisions.why: the session already held the feature context; the user did not ask for subagents
decisions.rejected: fan-out worker per fan-out.md

decisions.decision: Upsert organisations then contacts immediately after Members, ahead of JournalEntries
decisions.why: Contacts and JournalEntries.ExternalOrganisationId both FK to organisations; SQLite enforces FKs on SaveChanges ordering per tracked graph
decisions.rejected: Upserting them after JournalEntries

decisions.decision: Organisation lists are optional, not gated in ValidateCompleteness
decisions.why: FR-015: a 1.2.0 file must restore with an empty register
decisions.rejected: Requiring the new EntityCounts keys

decisions.decision: New integration test writes its recovery copy to a private temp folder
decisions.why: Glob-deleting StageFright-Recovery-*.sfbak in the shared temp dir raced V9_BackupRestoreTests' read-back verification
decisions.rejected: Reusing V9's shared-temp cleanup pattern

plan.summary: Full plan, research, data model and UI contract for the external organisations register with linked expense/income history
plan.key_finding: Linking at the JournalEntry header keeps ledger lines immutable and makes the history amount a simple debit sum
